notebooks.title: 圆周切空间与弧长
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
t=sp.symbols('t',real=True)
p=sp.Matrix([2*sp.cos(t),2*sp.sin(t)]);v=p.diff(t)/2
print('位置/速度/速率:',p.subs(t,sp.pi/6),v.subs(t,sp.pi/6),sp.simplify(sp.sqrt(v.dot(v))))
x,y=sp.symbols('x y',real=True);c=sp.Matrix([x*x+y*y-4]);D=c.jacobian([x,y])
print('正则圆Jacobian/核:',D.subs({x:2,y:0}),D.subs({x:2,y:0}).nullspace())
print('圆弧长:',sp.integrate(sp.sqrt(p.diff(t).dot(p.diff(t))),(t,0,sp.pi/2)))
print('度量系数:',sp.simplify(p.diff(t).dot(p.diff(t))))
D0=sp.Matrix([x*x+y*y]).jacobian([x,y]).subs({x:0,y:0})
print('退化零水平集Jacobian/核维数:',D0,len(D0.nullspace()))

notebooks.title: 坐标推前与李导数
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
x,y,a,b=sp.symbols('x y a b',real=True);Phi=sp.Matrix([x,y+x*x]);D=Phi.jacobian([x,y]);f=sp.Matrix([y,0]);g=sp.Matrix([0,1]);h=x*x+y
Lf=(sp.Matrix([h]).jacobian([x,y])*f)[0];Lg=(sp.Matrix([h]).jacobian([x,y])*g)[0]
print('变换/行列式/推前:',Phi.subs({x:1,y:2}),D.det(),(D*f).subs({x:1,y:2}))
print('Lie导数/复合:',Lf,Lg,sp.diff(Lf,y),'默认:',Lf.subs({x:1,y:2}),Lg,sp.diff(Lf,y).subs(x,1))
Psi=sp.Matrix([sp.exp(a)*sp.cos(b),sp.exp(a)*sp.sin(b)])
print('非全局逆行列式/周期差:',sp.simplify(Psi.jacobian([a,b]).det()),sp.simplify(Psi.subs(b,b+2*sp.pi)-Psi))
t=sp.symbols('t',real=True);sol=1/(1-t)
print('流例方程/初值:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(sol,t)-sol**2),sol.subs(t,0))

notebooks.title: 四段流与李括号
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
x,y,t=sp.symbols('x y t',real=True);z=sp.Matrix([x,y,t]);f=sp.Matrix([sp.cos(t),sp.sin(t),0]);g=sp.Matrix([0,0,1]);br=g.jacobian(z)*f-f.jacobian(z)*g
print('括号:',br,'零朝向:',br.subs(t,0))
e=sp.symbols('e',positive=True);d=sp.Matrix([e*(1-sp.cos(e)),-e*sp.sin(e)])
print('归一化极限:',[sp.limit(v/e**2,e,0) for v in d])
for v in [.1,.25,.5,.8]:
    exact=np.array([float(a.subs(e,v)) for a in d]);approx=np.array([0.,-v*v]);print('段时长/精确/二阶/误差/总时长:',v,exact,approx,np.linalg.norm(exact-approx),4*v)
print('默认归一化:',np.array([float(a.subs(e,.5)) for a in d])/.25)

notebooks.title: 分布的秩与可积性
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
x,y,z=sp.symbols('x y z',real=True);vars=sp.Matrix([x,y,z]);F=sp.Matrix([1,0,-y/2]);G=sp.Matrix([0,1,x/2]);br=G.jacobian(vars)*F-F.jacobian(vars)*G
print('非对合括号/二场秩/三场行列式:',br,sp.Matrix.hstack(F,G).rank(),sp.Matrix.hstack(F,G,br).det())
a=sp.Matrix([1,0,0]);b=sp.Matrix([0,1,0]);print('平面分布括号:',b.jacobian(vars)*a-a.jacobian(vars)*b)
t=sp.symbols('t',real=True);f=sp.Matrix([sp.cos(t),sp.sin(t),0]);g=sp.Matrix([0,0,1]);B=sp.Matrix([sp.sin(t),-sp.cos(t),0])
print('差速三方向行列式:',sp.simplify(sp.Matrix.hstack(f,g,B).det()))

notebooks.title: 旋转约束与矩阵指数
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
O=sp.Matrix([[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,0]]);t=sp.symbols('t',real=True)
R=sp.Matrix([[sp.cos(t),-sp.sin(t),0],[sp.sin(t),sp.cos(t),0],[0,0,1]])
print('正交/行列式:',sp.simplify(R.T*R),sp.simplify(R.det()))
print('切向约束:',sp.simplify(R.T*R.diff(t)+(R.diff(t)).T*R))
print('pi2旋转与基向量:',R.subs(t,sp.pi/2),R.subs(t,sp.pi/2)*sp.Matrix([1,0,0]))
lin=sp.eye(3)+O;print('线性步正交残差/行列式:',lin.T*lin-sp.eye(3),lin.det())
print('expm数值差:',np.max(np.abs(expm(np.array(O,dtype=float)*np.pi/2)-np.array(R.subs(t,sp.pi/2),dtype=float))))
print('周期差:',sp.simplify(R.subs(t,t+2*sp.pi)-R))

notebooks.title: 相对阶与退化坐标
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
a,b=sp.symbols('a b',real=True);vars=sp.Matrix([a,b]);f=sp.Matrix([b,0]);g=sp.Matrix([0,1])
def lie(v,h):return (sp.Matrix([h]).jacobian(vars)*v)[0]
for h in [a,a*a]:
    Lf=lie(f,h);Lg=lie(g,h);dec=lie(g,Lf);T=sp.Matrix([h,Lf]);print('输出/Lg/Lf/LgLf/变换行列式:',h,Lg,Lf,dec,sp.factor(T.jacobian(vars).det()))
print('平方输出默认/退化系数:',(2*a).subs(a,1),(2*a).subs(a,0))

O=sp.Matrix([[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,0]]);print('题6:',O.T+O,(sp.eye(3)+O).T*(sp.eye(3)+O)-sp.eye(3),(sp.eye(3)+O).det(),2*x,4*x*x)
